what: AR55, the return card's look, for TR53: research's pick of 2026-11-23, 19:09 (A's card; B's tab for the run; the notice out of the tab). Every word is research's (docs/asset-requests.md, AR55, 'Research's pick'): this file holds where words sit, never the words.
units: points at the smallest phone (568 x 320); every box is left, top, width, height; a word's y is its capitals' top; images at 4 pixels a point, edge alpha 0. An image's `origin` is where its lay point sits in it, in points from its top left (times 4 for pixels)
strict: the sheets stand the HUD's pieces where a capture has them on screen (build/captures/tr50/fix-line.png) and draw the kit's sizes at one to one. The game draws at 0.85 on that phone (Theme.Scale.Floor), so it has about a sixth more room than the sheets: every fit here is the strict case. Anchor to the pieces (the Electricity pill's foot, the screen's right and foot, the line's foot), not to these screen numbers

card.note: the kit builds it: Panel in the System palette, a line a change, one Button. Boxes from the screen's top left unless said

slab.stands: under the Electricity pill (its foot at 128): 186 points to the card's foot; the card is 182 tall with four lines, 183 with five. The dock, the pills and the lead's card stay; the next step's plate waits while the card is up

lines.frame: from the slab's top left; line k's top is 26 + k x pitch

face.of: the Training machine's line: the Voidkin's small portrait's face, no frame
face.side: pitch - 8: the well inset 2, so its corners meet the well's cuts

images.training: the Voidkin's own face: the kit's small portrait (Portrait<Name>Small, or PortraitUnknown<Rarity>Small), its face's square
images.shard: the shard's small picture, of the shard that broke (build/handoff/UI/shards)

lines.widest: the battery's: ten characters as Read.Kwh writes a gain under 100 ('+12.40 kWh') beside 'stored'; the slab's 188 holds it in the sheet's face

press.box: inset 8 from the slab's sides, its top 50 over the slab's foot, 44 tall
press.reveal: the kit's Ready button, when a shard is among the lines

run.note: boxes from the run's line's glass's top left, as AR53's dare (build/handoff/UI/goals/goals.json)

tab.make: the line's own glass, under it, corners cut 4: the dare's tab's twin, 6 to its right; its place holds when the dare's tab is absent

picture.image: the shard's small picture, of the shard that broke (build/handoff/UI/shards)

words.text: the time left, as Read gives it

tab.rides: the open dare's foot while a dare is open (build/handoff/UI/goals/goals.json, dare, line, unfolded): its top as far above that foot as above the line's, so 26 lower under one row, 44 under two, in goals.json's points
tab.hard: the same tab in the Hard line's glass
tab.none: no shard in the Breaker: no tab

notice.make: the same glass, corners cut 6, opened to the right from the tab
notice.right: 6 short of the Electricity pill at this phone
notice.waits: for the dare's close when a dare is open
notice.note: not the kit's toast: that stays one line

ReturnSeat.use: a line's well, under its picture

ReturnSeatLight.use: over the well, under the picture: the machine's light

ReturnGlow.use: behind the shard's picture in the run's tab once it reads Ready

motion: nothing moves here beyond what the kit does. The card's rise, a line's count, the tab's opening and its fold back to Ready are TR53's block, and research reads them in motion there
